description: This file manages transport stream functions for different AI models and APIs, including support checks, alias resolution, and stream function creation based on model configurations.

methods.name: createSupportedTransportStreamFn
methods.description: Creates a transport stream function based on the provided API type.

methods.name: hasTransportOverrides
methods.description: Checks if the model has transport override configurations like proxy or TLS.

methods.name: isTransportAwareApiSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given API is supported for transport-aware operations.

methods.name: resolveTransportAwareSimpleApi
methods.description: Resolves the simple alias for a given API.

methods.name: createTransportAwareStreamFnForModel
methods.description: Creates a transport stream function for a model if transport overrides are present and supported.

methods.name: createBoundaryAwareStreamFnForModel
methods.description: Creates a boundary-aware stream function for a model if the API is supported.

methods.name: prepareTransportAwareSimpleModel
methods.description: Prepares a model with transport-aware API aliasing if applicable.

methods.name: buildTransportAwareSimpleStreamFn
methods.description: Builds a transport-aware simple stream function for a model.
